items.title: Armani: LVMH bows out, L’Oréal and Essilux negotiate for 15% stake
items.why: Ownership shifts at a major fashion house can change which luxury partners are available for card perks.
items.summary_ai: LVMH has reportedly stepped back from a stake in Armani, with L'Oréal and Essilux now negotiating for 15%.
items.take: Ownership shifts at a major fashion house can change which luxury partners are available for card perks.
